In [[137 ABY]], a [[Codru-Ji]] '''clan''' was led by [[Rikkar-Du]]. Due to his [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to [[Tassa]], the clan was a union of Rikkar-Du's people, and a [[Tassa's clan|clan]] led by [[Tassa's father]].
